title: Anthropic says it found 5,500 verified vulnerabilities in April-October and Glasswing partners found 129K+ in April-July; 33K+ were critical or high severity (Reuters)
summary: Reuters: Anthropic says it found 5,500 verified vulnerabilities in April-October and Glasswing partners found 129K+ in April-July; 33K+ were critical or high severity — Anthropic is expanding a program that allows vetted cybersecurity professionals to test its most powerful AI models with fewer safeguards …
